# ScrimHQ

> ScrimHQ is a competitive scrimmage platform for esports teams. Find opponents, schedule scrims, manage rosters, and track match history across 12+ games.

ScrimHQ helps team captains and competitive players coordinate practice matches (scrims), build and manage their roster, send and accept challenges from other teams, and keep a verified record of match results and team reliability.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ScrimHQ, supported games, and how the platform works.
- [Sign In or Create Account](/auth): Sign in or create a captain account to start using ScrimHQ.
